name: synthetic-measurement-review
description: Extract each explicitly reported measurement and its calculation scenario. Preserve separate statements and conflicting identities. Use exact source text for values, units and quotes; do not infer missing conditions or select one conflicting identity.

parameter.description: The reported parameter, preserving component versus total distinctions.

value.description: Exact original value token, identical to reading.value_text.

conditions.description: Original scenario or reaction assumption for this measurement, with its own exact quote.
